ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: World Domination Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.1.0
Compatibility patch: World Domination 2.0 bases, turrets and travelers are classified, populated and owned under Regions and Societies territory rules.
Features: - Typed sorting: travelers (raids, drop pods, road builders, purchase parties) count as caravans; WD outposts hold ground with their real pawn count as population. - Turrets hold ground: automated turrets classify as military installations that hold territory. - Ruins release territory: a destroyed World Domination settlement becomes scenery and stops claiming its region.
Requires: Regions and Societies and World Domination 2.0. No settings of its own - governance toggles live in Regions and Societies.
--- Changelog (v0.1.0) --- - Initial release: World Domination integration extracted from Regions and Societies core into a typed compatibility patch binding World Domination's assembly directly.
Source: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/World-Domination-CP Support development: https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
